rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for foolish or silly acts and behavior.

example.english: Your constant buffoonery is really giving me a headache.
example.traditional: 你成日做埋啲傻事，真係令人頭痛。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 zou6 maai4 di1 so4 si6 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 tau4 tung3

rows.note: Use this when the silliness is deliberate clowning or showboating rather than merely a foolish mistake.

example.english: You don't need all that buffoonery in front of the customers—just get on with your work.
example.traditional: 你唔使喺客人面前扮嘢，認真做嘢啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 hai2 haak3 jan4 min6 cin4 baan6 je5 jing6 zan1 zou6 je5 laa1
